sources.name: Geolocation API of Digitaal Vlaanderen (Geopunt)
sources.description: The Flemish address register (Basisregisters Vlaanderen) as a geocoder, with the Brussels UrbIS addresses alongside: search, reverse, house-number precision. Its matching is loose on house numbers; the adapter checks the number it matched. Read by formats/geocoding/belgium.ts.
sources.attribution: © Digitaal Vlaanderen — Basisregisters Vlaanderen; © Paradigm — UrbIS

sources.name: Basisregisters Vlaanderen
sources.description: The Flemish base registers: addresses, streets, municipalities (by NIS code), parcels and buildings, each with a persistent identifier.

sources.name: UrbIS geolocation service
sources.description: The Brussels address register (UrbIS) as a geocoder: addresses in French or Dutch, with how well each part matched. Reverse lookup takes Belgian Lambert 72 only.

sources.name: ICAR geocoding service (geocodeWS)
sources.description: The Walloon address register (ICAR, inventaire centralisé des adresses et des rues) as a geocoder: search, reverse, a match score per level and the NIS code of the municipality. Its terms of use are still being drafted by the Service public de Wallonie, so what it returns is not passed on.
sources.license: Free and open access; terms of use being drafted (not verified)

sources.name: RMI automatic weather stations
sources.description: Observations of the automatic weather stations of the Royal Meteorological Institute (IRM / KMI), every 10 minutes, hour and day: temperature, wind, humidity, global irradiance, through OGC WFS. A network of 14 stations, not a grid.
sources.license: CC-BY-4.0 (as stated by the Belgian Climate Centre catalogue; not verified on opendata.meteo.be)

sources.name: Statbel — Statistics Belgium, open data
sources.description: The statistics office's open data, among them the official list of municipalities with their NIS codes and the statistical sectors.

sources.name: Crossroads Bank for Enterprises (KBO / BCE)
sources.description: The official register of Belgian enterprises and their establishments, searched by enterprise number.

sources.name: Fluvius open data
sources.description: The Flemish distribution operators' open datasets: load profiles, installed capacity of solar panels, network data by municipality.

sources.name: Elia open data
sources.description: The transmission operator's open datasets: load, generation, cross-border exchanges, balancing and CO2 intensity of the country.

sources.name: ENTSO-E — list of Y EIC codes (areas)
sources.description: The list of area codes of the European electricity market, with their functions: bidding zone, control area, scheduling area.

sources.name: Fluvius — What are quarter-hour values (kwartierwaarden)?
sources.description: The Flemish distribution operator's page on the quarter-hour readings of its digital electricity meter.

sources.name: Sibelga — consumption history
sources.description: The Brussels distribution operator's page on the history of a customer's consumption, quarter-hourly for a smart meter.

sources.name: ORES — the communicating meter
sources.description: The main Walloon distribution operator's page on how its communicating meter collects consumption by quarter hour.

sources.name: Eurostat — electricity prices components for household consumers, annual (nrg_pc_204_c)
sources.description: Yearly electricity prices of households by consumption band and component: energy and supply, network costs, taxes and levies, VAT.

sources.name: Eurostat — electricity prices components for non-household consumers, annual (nrg_pc_205_c)
sources.description: Yearly electricity prices of non-household consumers by consumption band and component.

sources.name: FPS Finance — Your energy bill (Uw energiefactuur)
sources.description: The federal tax administration's page on the VAT rate of natural gas and electricity and the excise reform that came with it.
